newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-SANCHEZ'S GOALS TAKE FEYENOORD TO THE TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SANCHEZ'S GOALS TAKE FEYENOORD TO THE TOP.

text.p: Argentine striker Pablo Sanchez scored both goals as Feyenoord beat NAC Breda 2-0 on Sunday to move to the top of the Dutch first division.
Feyenoord have 69 points, one more than PSV Eindhoven, who did not play this weekend but could regain top spot on Wednesday when they play Sparta Rotterdam.
Sanchez opened the scoring in the 13th minute when he took advantage of a defensive error by NAC midfielder Barry van Galen.
His second and 13th of the season came five minutes into the second half. He followed up to score after his own shot had hit the post.
Ajax Amsterdam, already well out of the title hunt, suffered a surprise 2-1 defeat away at Sparta Rotterdam.

Ajax, missing injured strikers Patrick Kluivert and Marc Overmars, were 1-0 down after 17 minutes when Dennis de Nooyer beat the offside trap to score. The club's top scorer last season had not scored since November 23.
Ajax equalised in the 31st minute when Frank de Boer curved a free kick from 18 metres around the wall.
The winner came just one minute from time, Arjan van der Laan heading home a Dennis de Nooyer cross.

AZ Alkmaar improved their chances of avoiding relegation after just one season in the top flight with a 2-2 draw against Volendam. They remain at the bottom, three points behind their nearest rivals NEC Nijmegen and RKC Waalwijk.
Only the bottom club are automatically relegated. The 16th and 17th placed teams play off with six second division teams for two first division berths.
